description: The app's sales (Money › Sales in the dashboard). "list" { status?, productId?, from?, to?, seller?, skip?, limit? }: newest first, each with product, units, paid (minor units) and currency when known, status (completed | refunded | charged_back | ended), refund and dispute, the buyer's userId, email and buyerName, canRefund, and the seller who was paid (seller, sellerName). "documents" { saleId }: the links Stripe keeps for the buyer, a payment's receipt (receiptUrl) or a subscription's invoices (url, pdf); nothing is stored. The buyer's email is personal data. Changes nothing; neblla_sales refunds.
